hero.eyebrow: M&L Software · Software house · São Paulo
hero.headline: Software engineering for operations that can't stop.
hero.subheadline: Our team builds and modernizes the systems behind payments, documents, customer service and integrations — production code, not just prototypes.

pillars.heading: We solve operational pain, not just technical problems
pillars.subheading: Our work is organized around the problems our clients need to solve.

payments.title: Payments & Financial Reconciliation
payments.why: Every unreconciled payment turns into manual rework, error risk and cash no one can see clearly.
payments.what: We build end-to-end PIX payment pipelines, automated real-time reconciliation and integrations with banks and payment providers.
payments.result: Real-time PIX reconciliation for a Brazilian payments fintech, an M&L client, handling six-figure monthly volume.

documents.title: Document Automation & Back-office
documents.why: Manual document issuing and review bottleneck the back-office and don't scale as the operation grows.
documents.what: We automate invoice issuing and document workflows, and apply AI to analyze, validate and approve documents safely.
documents.result: 120 invoices per minute with zero data loss, and 5 to 10 minutes of manual review removed per document with AI.

whatsapp.title: Customer Service & WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.why: Your customers are already on WhatsApp. A poorly protected bot, however, becomes an entry point for fraud and data leaks.
whatsapp.what: We integrate the WhatsApp Business API into notifications and AI-powered service, with security testing against prompt injection and phishing before going live.
whatsapp.result: Production WhatsApp chatbot tested against prompt injection and phishing.

legacy.title: Integrations & Legacy System Modernization
legacy.why: Legacy systems and fragile integrations make every change slow, expensive and risky.
legacy.what: We connect systems, third-party APIs and providers, and migrate legacy stacks to modern architectures incrementally.
legacy.result: Incremental migration of a legacy .NET stack to a modern TypeScript architecture, carried out while the operation kept running.

packages.heading: How you can work with us
packages.subheading: Three formats, designed for different moments of your operation.

squad.name: Dedicated Engineering Squad
squad.description: A senior squad dedicated to your operation for a fraction of the cost of an in-house team. Ideal for continuously evolving product and systems.

automation.description: A project with defined scope, timeline and price to automate a specific process: reconciliation, document issuing, integrations.

ai.name: Operational AI Sprint
ai.description: AI applied to documents and customer service, with human validation where it matters and security testing before going live.
includes: Testing against prompt injection and phishing
